title: Tropic Stab
description: A bright supersaw chord-stab lead locked to an offbeat dembow stab pattern — each hit bites with a fast filter envelope that opens wider across the loop as the ladder-filter cutoff climbs on a slow 24-cycle arc. Detune drifts lazily on a 13-cycle sine for supersaw thickness, while pan swings on a mutually-prime 11-cycle LFO and dotted-eighth delay throws notes into the festival crowd. Over 28 cycles the stab morphs from tight and punchy to wide and shimmering before cycling back.
code:
setcpm(100/4)
stack(
  note("<[~ eb4] [~ g4] [~ eb4] [~ [g4 bb4]]>/2")
    .s("supersaw")
    .detune(sine.slow(13).range(0.2, 0.9).add("<0 0.3 0 0.5 0 0.2>/7"))
    .lpf(sine.slow(24).range(600, 4800)).resonance(sine.slow(11).range(3, 11)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(sine.slow(17).range(3, 8)).lpattack(0.01).lpdecay(0.2)
    .attack(0.005).decay(0.18).sustain(0.3).release(0.08)
    .pan(sine.slow(11).range(0.25, 0.75))
    .shape(sine.slow(32).range(0.05, 0.28))
    .delay("0.5:0.375:0.6")
    .room(sine.slow(17).range(0.1, 0.35))
    .off(0.375, x => x.add(note(7)).gain(0.28).pan(sine.slow(13).range(0.7, 0.3)))
    .gain(0.92)
)
